summary.text: Ashlei Spivey is a member of the Nebraska Legislature (Unicameral) representing District 13, serving since 2024. Her committee assignments are Appropriations, Committee on Committees and State-Tribal Relations.

paragraphs.text: According to her legislative biography, Spivey was born August 15, 1986, in Omaha and graduated from Omaha North High Magnet School in 2004.
She studied communications and marketing at Jackson State University and earned a graduate degree in urban social planning from the University of Texas at Arlington.

Her biography lists her occupation as nonprofit executive director, with past work as a restaurant owner, bank vice president and nonprofit program officer, and past service as president of the ACLU of Nebraska board.
It lists her as married to Universal Arthur since May 9, 2022, with two children, and notes honors including USA Today's 2024 Nebraska Woman of the Year.
